evidence: 'Eric B. Is President' (Zakia, June 1986) samples the Honey Drippers' 'Impeach the President' alongside James Brown's 'Funky President' and Mountain's 'Long Red', and interpolates Fonda Rae's 'Over Like a Fat Rat' for its bassline (Wikipedia's article on the single).

trackPair.whatToListenFor: Listen to the drum intro of 'Impeach the President': a dry, tight kick and snare with a hi-hat, every hit distinct. On 'Eric B. Is President' those drums sit under a rolling bassline and scratches, with very little else on top. The space in the track is what lets Rakim's calm, low delivery come through. He does not have to shout over anything.

explanation.age13: Eric B. & Rakim's first single used drums from the Honey Drippers' 'Impeach the President', one of the most sampled drum breaks ever. They put very little else over it apart from a bassline and scratching, which left lots of room for Rakim's calm, clever rapping.
explanation.adult: 'Impeach the President' was already on its way to being a standard break (it is linked to Marley Marl and Biz Markie on this map), and 'Eric B. Is President' is one of its first major uses. Who produced the track is disputed. Marley Marl is often credited, and Eric B. has said he paid Marley as the engineer and brought the music himself. The edge is from the break, so it does not have to settle that.
